summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 tests) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed, and no existing files were changed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement was checked by reading only. All lines are within 88 columns. Choices I made: a non-BNode guard after the Literal and IRI checks, to keep None from acting as a graph wildcard; and invalid-case type-ignores placed on the call line inside the pytest.raises block.
